title: CROS Conformance Profile — Offline DCC Path Tracing
statusNote: DECLARED ONLY. No adapter implements this profile. Every requirement below is an expectation placed on future adapters, not a description of current behaviour. There is no Cycles, Arnold, RenderMan, Karma, or Redshift integration in this package, and no stub pretending to be one.
scope: Offline, deterministic-by-construction rendering in a locked environment: DCC scene → path tracer → frames on disk.

replay.claim: Under a locked environment with pinned seeds, pinned sample counts, and a deterministic reduction order, re-execution is expected to yield byte-equal outputs. This expectation is UNVERIFIED — no adapter exists to test it against. Until an adapter demonstrates it, the honest default class is deterministic-parameters.
replay.defaultRationale: bit-identical is permitted but not the default. Claiming byte equality requires having observed byte equality; permitting a class is not the same as achieving it.

requirements.title: Environment lock
requirements.requirement: The adapter must record an exact, resolvable environment identity: renderer version, plugin/shader versions, OS and libc, GPU driver where the render path is GPU-accelerated, and OCIO config version.
requirements.whyBitIdenticalNeedsIt: A minor renderer or driver revision can change intersection tie-breaks or math intrinsics. Without a recorded lock, byte equality is unfalsifiable.

requirements.title: RNG seed pinning
requirements.requirement: Every stochastic component (sampler, ray-differential jitter, volumetric scatter, stochastic transparency) must draw from an explicitly seeded stream, and every seed must be recorded.

requirements.title: Sample-count and adaptivity pinning
requirements.requirement: Sample counts must be recorded per AOV. Adaptive sampling must record its threshold and its termination decision inputs, or be disabled.
requirements.note: Adaptive sampling driven by a wall-clock or noise-estimate budget is the most common silent breaker of bit-identical replay: identical inputs terminate at different sample counts on differently-loaded hardware.

requirements.title: Deterministic reduction order
requirements.requirement: Sample accumulation and multi-tile/multi-device merges must occur in a fixed order. Floating-point addition is not associative, so an arrival-order reduction produces run-to-run variance even with identical samples.

requirements.title: Scene state content addressing
requirements.requirement: The resolved scene graph — post-referencing, post-procedural-expansion — must be content-hashed, along with every referenced asset (geometry, textures, volumes).

requirements.title: Color management declaration
requirements.requirement: Working space, view transform, and display transform must be recorded by OCIO config identity and version.
requirements.note: ACES is the expected common case. This package implements no color management whatsoever; naming ACES here is a target, not a capability.

requirements.title: Denoiser disclosure
requirements.requirement: Any denoise pass must be recorded with model identity and version, and must be applied as a declared post-step so that pre-denoise output remains independently hashable.
requirements.note: A learned denoiser's version is part of the environment lock. OIDN/OptiX integration is not implemented.

requirements.title: Distributed execution accounting
requirements.requirement: Where a render is split across hosts, each unit of work must be attributable and independently hashable, and the merge must satisfy DCC-R4.
requirements.note: No farm planner, scheduler, or work-distribution layer exists in this package.

invariantStatusNote: CI-002 is 'declared' rather than 'partial' for this profile specifically: cros.planning.derive_plan raises UnsupportedProfileError for cros.dcc-offline. There is no offline planner. CI-001 remains 'partial' because intent hashing is profile-independent and is implemented.
requiredEvidenceFieldsNote: Declared expectation. cros.evidence enforces requiredEvidenceFields for cros.gen-ai-nim only; the offline field set is not machine-checked because no producer exists to check.
